name: Campingplatz Pfronten
beschreibung:
Situated right on the border between Tyrol and the Allgaeu, Campingplatz Pfronten provides excellent conditions for an active and refreshing holiday. Guests enjoy unhindered mountain views alongside modern campsite infrastructure.

The region entices with cable cars, via ferratas, scenic hiking paths, and cycling trails. In winter, reliable ski and cross-country resorts in the Tannheimer Tal and Ausserfern are just minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Campingplatz Pfronten scores with its prime location on the Tyrolean border offering superb alpine outdoor sports.
